why: This is a single study's 11-week implementation of teacher-delivered phonological-awareness instruction for a specific kindergarten population and setting, rather than a reusable instructional element or clearly named adoptable programme.
This is a study-specific assessment instrument for rating microscope suitability, not a general instructional element.
name: 11-criteria microscope-suitability questionnaire with 5-point grading scale
product_description: A subjective 11-criterion, five-point questionnaire developed by Awad et al. to evaluate magnification devices for microsurgical training after simulated suturing and anastomosis tasks.
